stages.title: Stage 34 — Reverse Engineering Performance
stages.subtitle: Identifying Performance Bottlenecks & Hazards in Binaries

details.title: Performance Analysis Checklist
items: Identifying cold startup bottlenecks and blocking synchronous calls
Locating long-running initialization logic executed on the main UI thread
Auditing excessive memory allocations and primitive wrapper boxing
Identifying frequent garbage collection triggers (High allocation rates in inner loops)
Tracing Binder IPC contention & blocking synchronous `transact` calls
Auditing thread pools, executor starvation, and thread priority misconfigurations
Locating potential deadlock conditions and circular synchronization wait graphs
Auditing Application Not Responding (ANR) risk paths in receivers and services
Tracing network request bottlenecks (Uncached requests, lack of compression)
Identifying UI rendering bottlenecks (Deep view trees, overdraw, main thread layout passes)
Understanding how compiler optimizations (Inlining, DCE, Loop unrolling) alter runtime assembly

stages.title: Stage 35 — Runtime Investigation Workflow
stages.subtitle: Systematic Inquiry Checklist for Runtime Analysis

details.title: Runtime State Inquiry Checklist
items: Which Linux process is currently executing this target code?
Which specific thread is executing this function (UI Thread vs Worker Thread)?
What is the current process importance (`oom_score_adj`) and cgroup placement?
Where is memory being allocated (Java Heap, Native Heap, or Direct Mappings)?
Which Garbage Collection events may be triggered by this allocation path?
Which Binder IPC calls are executing synchronously and blocking the calling thread?
Is application startup optimized with Baseline Profiles and lazy initialization?
Is UI rendering executing hardware-accelerated on the RenderThread or blocking the UI thread?
Which background work execution model is scheduled (WorkManager, JobScheduler, Service)?
Is device power management (Doze, App Standby, Thermal Throttling) altering execution behavior?

details.title: Core Investigation Principle
items: Build a mental execution model that combines static DEX/Native disassembly analysis with dynamic runtime trace monitoring.
